name: self-hosted-llm-evals-lab
description: Evaluation framework for self-hosted LLMs. Systematic prompt ablation (baseline, CoT, few-shot, self-consistency voting) on Llama 3.1 8B via lm-evaluation-harness, with Wilson CI statistical analysis, determinism validation, and load testing under concurrency. Found chain-of-thought degrades accuracy 25pp at small scale.
